issue.title: the planning phase names the requirements citation the criteria write demands, so a run pays one consult for it and not two
issue.description:
## What happened

Phase 3 of the issue-flow guide says the plan and the criteria are both read by a consult before the
issue takes them, and names nothing else either write demands. The `approved` entry check demands
one more thing: that the description, the plan or the criteria name a clause of the requirements
tree, written `<id>~<rev>`.

A run that follows the phase as written pays for the omission in consults. On ISS-488, read at
c8771d6 and shipped at b95a379:

```
$ forge record criteria ISS-488 <criteria.md>
  no clause of this project's requirements tree is named by the description, the plan or the
  criteria, and a citation is `<id>~<rev>`
```

By then the consult had already read both files. Both writes refuse a file whose text has changed
since the consult read it — the right rule — so adding the citation costs a whole further consult on
both. Four planning consults where two would have done.

## Outcome

A run reads Phase 3 once and writes the plan and the criteria once.

## Rules

- The phase names every demand the two writes make, or names none and points at the one command that
  prints them. Half a list is worse than none, because a reader stops at the end of it.
- The demand is the project's, not the method's: a project with no requirements tree is asked for no
  citation. So the sentence belongs where it can say *where a project keeps one*, and the consult
  intent is what has to know before the file is written.
- Nothing about the refusal itself changes. It names the clause form and the command, and it is
  right to fire.

## Out of scope

Whether a criterion is the right home for the citation rather than the plan — the check takes any of
the three and this note asks only that the phase say so.

The re-read rule on `forge plan` and `forge record criteria`. It is what makes a consult mean
something, and the cost above is the phase's to remove, not that rule's.

## Where

- forge 3.35.183 at /run/media/thanh/New/ai-project/wt-ISS-488/plugin
- met from project forge-plugin (.forge.json), prose as written
- agent claude-code_2-1-258_agent, in /run/media/thanh/New/ai-project/wt-ISS-488
